events.verdict: Gordon (DEN) goes to, not through, Joe's (OKC) space as Gordon releases away from the contact.
There is no clear or conclusive camera angle to determine if Joe (OKC) makes any contact with Gordon's (DEN) arm during his contest of the jump shot attempt.
Williams (OKC) clamps and holds Jokic's (DEN) arm, which affects his ability to pursue the rebound. Although the foul is reported on Williams, it is attributed to Dort (OKC) in the play-by-play.
Hardaway Jr. (DEN) moves alongside Mitchell's (OKC) path as he defends the shot attempt.
Dort (OKC) flails his arm and delivers unnecessary contact to Jokic's (DEN) head/face.  After communicating with the Replay Center, the foul was upgraded to a flagrant foul penalty 1.
Murray (DEN) establishes himself in Williams' (OKC) path prior to the contact.
Williams (OKC) legally contests Jokic's (DEN) jump shot attempt.
Dort (OKC) absorbs the contact from Braun (DEN) as he sets the screen.
Braun (DEN) and Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC) briefly engage and disengage off-ball.
Gordon (DEN) legally contests Joe's (OKC) jump shot attempt.
Williams (OKC) maintains a legal guarding position alongside Jokic's (DEN) path as he defends the shot attempt.
Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC) is bracing for the contact from Braun (DEN) and he releases away from the contact.
Braun (DEN) legally contests Gilgeous-Alexander's (OKC) jump shot attempt.
Mitchell (OKC) and Murray (DEN) briefly engage and disengage during the inbound.

Williams (OKC) moves through Murray's (DEN) space and dislodges him from his legally obtained position.  After communicating with the Replay Center, it is determined the contact occurs after Jokic (DEN) has started his upward shooting motion.  The basket is scored and Murray receives one free throw.
Jones (DEN) legally contests Gilgeous-Alexander's (OKC) jump shot attempt.
Mitchell (OKC) legally contests Gordon's (DEN) shot attempt.
